identityMap.Radiance: luminous blonde adult lead seated at center
identityMap.Alia: Black adult woman at left with the same anchored face and a new high sculptural braided ponytail, plus a few fine face-framing braids
identityMap.AI ECE: brunette adult strategist carrying the rainbow-finish mission sidearm

cast.rule: Preserve these four distinct adult faces, facial proportions, skin tones, and eye relationships. Alia alone receives the new braided signature hairstyle while her face remains unchanged. Do not clone, merge, age-shift, or substitute faces.
cast.aliaHairLock: High sculptural braided ponytail with clean braided roots and two or three fine face-framing braids. Country color may appear only as a narrow woven accent or small metal cuff. Keep her hair unmistakably braided in every image.

countryFashion.palette: Derive the dominant couture palette from the current country's flag colors.
countryFashion.motifs: Abstract respectful secular architecture, landscape, flora, fauna, civilian craft geometry, food and festival culture, and local material cues into seams, jewelry, footwear, surface pattern, and beacon design.

motifCoverage.flagMotifRule: When the national flag contains a recognizable secular non-protected motif, render a large complete fashion adaptation of that motif on at least two of the four characters. Do not reduce it to a tiny pin or trim.
motifCoverage.fallbackRule: When the flag has no motif, or its motif is official, sacred, political, or otherwise unsuitable for fashion copying, select the country's most recognizable non-official secular cultural symbols and render at least one large readable motif across two or more character looks. Good sources include civilian festivals, food and drink vessels, flora, fauna, architecture, craft, engineering, landscape, music, and everyday design.
motifCoverage.sceneRule: Use different motif placements and scales across the selected outfits, such as a full bodice graphic, skirt panel, structured hip piece, metallic applique, large embroidery field, or footwear construction. Keep motifs respectful, legible, and integrated into couture rather than pasted on.

countryFashion.prohibitions: No literal flags, official emblems, sacred symbols, political insignia, copied ceremonial dress, or generic rainbow replacement.
countryFashion.glamour: After-dark performance couture with dramatic heels, glossy or reflective tailoring, concise secure hemlines, and opaque lined coverage.

wardrobeUniqueness.rule: All four characters must have unmistakably different silhouettes, garment construction, hem architecture, material treatment, and footwear design in every image. Color changes alone do not count as unique styling.
wardrobeUniqueness.silhouetteSet: Choose four different structures per scene from sculpted mini dress, cropped bodice with asymmetric skirt, tailored short romper, strapless folded dress, high-waist shorts with architectural top, one-shoulder cocktail mini, peplum micro-suit, cutout column mini, corsage-inspired two-piece, or another equally distinct public-safe couture form.
wardrobeUniqueness.continuity: Do not repeat an outfit design within a batch or carry it unchanged into the next country. Preserve every triggered per-character midriff, strapless, and open-back roll while making the four resulting looks visibly different.

exposureArchitecture.neck: Fully unobstructed neck with no high collar, scarf, tie, or neck-covering layer.
exposureArchitecture.arms: Bare arms from shoulder to wrist with no sleeves.
exposureArchitecture.back: Open upper back and shoulder blades through a securely engineered backless or low-back silhouette.
exposureArchitecture.legs: Exposed legs through a short secure hem, high-cut tailored shorts, or asymmetric mini silhouette.
exposureArchitecture.front: Dramatic plunging, sweetheart, wrap, or sculpted low-cut neckline with secure opaque built-in support and no nipple or under-bust exposure.
exposureArchitecture.tone: Bold teasing adult glamour, intentional and confident, never accidental exposure or explicit framing.

romance.referenceDirection: Use scene 989's close spacing, waist embrace, linked hands, shoulder touch, opposing face directions, and visible relationship split as the minimum baseline. Future scenes should add more overlapping affection, clearer eye-line conflict, and less symmetry.
romance.rule: The four-way love triangle-square must be readable before the mission prop.
romance.compoundAffectionTarget: At least one image per four-scene batch must show a simultaneous three-person affection beat: one woman held in a full face-to-face or behind embrace while she gives another woman a quick cheek peck, forehead kiss, blown kiss at close range, or linked-hand invitation. The fourth woman supplies the rival emotional counter-beat.
signals: one cheek kiss or blown kiss
one side hug, behind hug, or protective shoulder hold
one jealous or excluded rival glance
one face-to-face smile within intimate conversational distance
one contested hand at a waist, shoulder, forearm, or beacon
one character choosing between two competing partners
ECE controlling the beacon while another character seeks her attention
romance.composition: Use asymmetrical bodies-in-motion staging with two clearly separate physical contacts and one emotional counter-beat. Avoid static lineups, equal spacing, parallel poses, and four people merely looking at a prop.

Ellie rises from a low mission stance into Radiance's waiting side hug while ECE keeps hold of Ellie's other hand and Alia watches with a wounded rival glance.
Alia spins Radiance under their linked hands; ECE steadies Radiance at the waist while Ellie reaches toward the beacon they are leaving behind.
ECE steps backward with the beacon while Radiance follows cheek-to-cheek; Ellie hooks an arm around Radiance's far shoulder and Alia blocks their route with a playful smile.
Radiance gives Alia a quick cheek kiss during a relay handoff; Ellie presses shoulder-to-shoulder with Radiance while ECE turns away, still holding Radiance's fingertips.
Ellie and Alia pull the same signal ribbon from opposite sides as Radiance places one calming hand on each of them and ECE leans close over Radiance's shoulder.
ECE kneels at the beacon while Radiance helps her rise with both hands; Ellie hugs Radiance from behind and Alia reaches down to ECE with a conflicted smile.
Alia carries the route card against Radiance's back while embracing her from behind; Ellie touches Radiance's cheek and ECE watches from inches away with controlled jealousy.
Radiance and Ellie share a face-to-face laugh mid-turn; ECE catches Ellie's wrist before she moves away and Alia places a steadying hand at Radiance's waist.
ECE controls the beacon overhead while Radiance circles an arm around her waist; Ellie reaches across Radiance to touch ECE's shoulder and Alia answers with a blown kiss.
Two characters sit close on a low mission plinth while a third leans into a behind hug and the fourth stands between their knees holding the beacon, visibly choosing whom to face.
The quartet crosses paths in a tight walking weave: one linked-hand pair, one protective back touch, one cheek-to-cheek pass, and one jealous look over a shoulder.
compoundLoveBeatRolls: Radiance is wrapped in Ellie's full face-to-face embrace while leaning sideways to give ECE a quick cheek peck; Alia keeps one hand at Radiance's back and watches the kiss with smiling jealousy.
ECE hugs Alia from behind with both arms around her waist while Alia reaches across to kiss Radiance's cheek; Ellie holds Radiance's hand and stares directly at ECE.
Ellie holds Radiance close at the waist and shoulder while Radiance gives Alia a forehead kiss; ECE steps between their linked hands and raises the beacon to reclaim attention.
Alia and Radiance share a full shoulder-to-shoulder embrace as Radiance blows a kiss toward ECE inches away; Ellie answers by touching ECE's cheek and keeping eye contact with Radiance.
ECE sits close against Radiance's side with Radiance's arm around her back; ECE gives Ellie a cheek peck while Alia kneels beside them and rests both hands over their joined hands.
Radiance embraces Ellie from behind while Ellie turns her face to meet Alia cheek-to-cheek; ECE gently catches Ellie's wrist before she can move closer.
Alia holds ECE in a face-to-face hug while ECE reaches past Alia to link fingers with Radiance; Ellie presses close at Radiance's shoulder and gives ECE a theatrical jealous look.
Ellie sits on a low mission plinth with Radiance standing between her knees in a close hug; Radiance gives Alia a quick cheek peck while ECE rests a hand at Ellie's shoulder and controls the beacon.
ECE and Radiance share a moving side hug as ECE gives Ellie a quick forehead kiss during the pass; Alia catches Radiance's free hand and pulls gently in the opposite direction.
Radiance cradles Alia's face with one hand while Alia hugs her waist; Ellie kisses Radiance's opposite cheek and ECE watches from inches away with one hand still linked to Radiance.

The quartet forms a turning embrace chain: Alia behind Radiance, Radiance face-to-face with Ellie, Ellie linking hands with ECE, and ECE leaning close enough to exchange a playful blown kiss with Radiance.
ECE is helped up from the beacon by Radiance into a close hug; ECE gives Alia a cheek peck over Radiance's shoulder while Ellie wraps both women in a protective side embrace.
romance.tone: Consensual adult affection, glamorous tension, tenderness, rivalry, deception, and reconciliation without explicit sexual activity.

eceRainbowHosieryCapsule.rule: Future images only. Make ECE's rainbow hosiery visibly colorful but vary the treatment every time: crisp stripes, soft ombre transitions, prismatic fades, two-to-four-color gradients, broken-spectrum blocks, diagonal color sweeps, painterly transitions, reflective color shifts, or asymmetric rainbow placement. Keep enough contrast to read as rainbow-inspired without requiring all seven colors in every look. Avoid repeating the same pattern in consecutive images. Keep hosiery opaque enough for public-safe editorial use and preserve complete heels or boots.

radianceEceRainbowHosieryRoll.selection: When active, use a second deterministic roll to choose exactly one wearer: 0 through 49 selects Radiance and 50 through 99 selects AI ECE.
radianceEceRainbowHosieryRoll.paletteMode: When active, use a third deterministic roll. Results 0 through 49 create a rainbow-like multicolor gradient anchored to the current country's base palette and expanded with harmonious transition hues. Results 50 through 99 use an original independent rainbow gradient unrelated to country colors.
radianceEceRainbowHosieryRoll.styles: Use varied public-safe opaque rainbow stockings or knee socks: soft ombre, prismatic fade, two-to-four-color gradient, broken-spectrum blocks, diagonal sweeps, reflective shifts, or asymmetric color placement. Avoid repeating the same treatment in consecutive images and make the stored palette-mode result visually clear.
radianceEceRainbowHosieryRoll.loveBeat: When active, Radiance and ECE become the unmistakable emotional center through a close embrace, linked hands, cheek-to-cheek reassurance, mutual delighted eye contact, or protective touch. Keep affection consensual, adult, public-safe, and non-explicit.
radianceEceRainbowHosieryRoll.propTransfer: When active, Alia becomes the sole mission-prop handler for that image while ECE remains route strategist through the separate holographic map.

eceMissionProp.design: Photorealistic full-size Desert Eagle-style mission sidearm with a vivid polished rainbow-gradient metal finish and realistic proportions, controls, grip, and reflections.
eceMissionProp.handling: Default handler is ECE. When the 25 percent Radiance/ECE rainbow-hosiery roll activates, Alia is the sole handler. Never use passive sky-pointing as the entire action. Build the scene around safe inert-prop choreography: sight alignment toward clearly empty water or a marked unoccupied route target, an unloaded inspection or magazine-free manipulation demonstration, a two-hand stance lesson, one woman guiding another's wrists from behind while the muzzle remains downrange, or a handoff with all trigger fingers indexed straight along the frame. The muzzle never crosses a person or the camera.
eceMissionProp.prohibitions: No low-side carry as the main pose, holster, display case, transparent enclosure, toy-like proportions, aiming at a person or camera, live reload, ammunition, firing, muzzle flash, threat, injury, combat, or fingers inside the trigger guard.
eceMissionProp.routeInterface: Route information appears as a separate floating holographic map controlled by ECE's free hand.

emotionRolls.scope: Roll independently for Radiance, Ellie, Alia, and AI ECE in every image using a stored deterministic integer from 0 through 99. Do not give all four characters the same emotion unless their independent rolls match.
emotionRolls.performance: Make each result readable in eyes, brows, mouth, breathing, tears where applicable, posture, touch pressure, and attention direction while preserving facial identity and attractive natural anatomy.

distribution.emotion: full sobbing with tear-streaked face and shaking posture

emotionRolls.interactionRule: Translate all four independent emotions into one coherent romance-square beat. Tears receive comfort or conflicted attention; joy creates shared motion; jealousy, anger, resentment, suspicion, guilt, shame, fear, and defiance remain consensual and nonviolent.

weatherRolls.scope: Roll once per image using a stored deterministic integer from 0 through 99. Weather affects the whole scene, lighting, fabric motion, hair, reflections, atmosphere, and landmark visibility.

distribution.weather: active lightning storm with distant bolts
hailstorm with suspended ice and hard backlight
powerful windstorm with controlled fabric motion
silent heat lightning on the horizon

weatherRolls.safetyRule: Rare weather is cinematic background and atmosphere only. Preserve clear faces, complete anatomy, stable footing, landmark readability, and no injury, disaster victim framing, or unsafe weapon handling.

sceneRolls.romanceBeat: deterministic rotation across kiss, hug, rivalry, choice, reconciliation, and beacon-control beats
sceneRolls.countryMotif: one primary and one secondary secular motif per image
sceneRolls.visibleMidriffPerCharacter: Roll independently for Radiance, Ellie, Alia, and AI ECE in every image. Results 0 through 49 of 100 expose the ordinary waist and belly button through a secure cropped-top, cutout-waist, or two-piece couture construction; results 50 through 99 keep the midriff covered. Never apply one shared roll to the whole image.
sceneRolls.straplessDressPerCharacter: Roll independently for Radiance, Ellie, Alia, and AI ECE in every image. Results 0 through 34 of 100 use a fully strapless dress with completely bare shoulders and no straps, strings, halter, sleeves, collar, illusion mesh, or shoulder attachments. Use secure opaque sculpted, folded, asymmetric, corsage-inspired, or architectural bodice engineering. Results 35 through 99 use the normal country-adapted silhouette.
sceneRolls.fullyOpenBackPerCharacter: Roll independently for Radiance, Ellie, Alia, and AI ECE in every image. Results 0 through 29 of 100 use a completely open-back silhouette from shoulder blades to the secure lower-back waistline, with no straps crossing the back, no fabric panel, no illusion mesh, and no cape or hair covering the design. Preserve secure opaque front and side construction. Results 30 through 99 use the normal back architecture.
sceneRolls.poleDanceTheme: 6 percent chance. Adult athletic stage-pole choreography only: controlled spins, climbs, static holds, mirrored partner poses, or supportive spotting. Integrate the pole as a beacon mast or route-marker prop while preserving country motifs, secure opaque couture, complete anatomy, and non-explicit editorial framing.
sceneRolls.paws: 25 percent deterministic chance on PAWS-eligible scenes only. When active, integrate PAWS into humor and affection: safely held in arms, gently touched by multiple characters, perched securely on a shoulder, batting at a route ribbon, interrupting a handoff, or prompting shared laughter. Never place PAWS near the prop muzzle, trigger, moving mechanism, or unsafe footing.
sceneRolls.rainbowHosiery: 25 percent per-image chance. Only Radiance or AI ECE may wear the rainbow stockings or knee socks, selected by a second deterministic roll. A third deterministic roll selects country-palette gradient at 0 through 49 or original independent rainbow gradient at 50 through 99. Trigger the stronger Radiance/ECE love beat and transfer the inert mission prop to Alia.
sceneRolls.rainbowOnly: 4 percent global picture chance. Results 0 through 3 of 100 make the entire quartet's outfits rainbow themed while preserving unique silhouettes and secure public-safe construction.

professionThemeRotation.layout: Each four-scene country batch uses the current theme for scenes one and two, then the next theme for scenes three and four. Advance the current theme by one position for the following country batch so adjacent batches overlap by one theme.
professionThemeRotation.integration: Merge each theme with the current country's palette, secular motifs, landmark, weather, rolled wardrobe architecture, emotions, romance-square contacts, PAWS state, rainbow rolls, and inert mission-prop beat. Keep every scene visually distinct.
professionThemeRotation.publicSafety: Use abstract fashion references only. No sexualized medical care, explicit dance or stripping, real assassination, injury, combat, official police badges, copied uniforms, impersonation, arrests, raids, or threats. Covert-agent and investigator themes are fictional film-editorial styling with nonviolent route missions.
